description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

An unconfirmed story claims a thief broke into a WWII veteran’s home and stole valuables, including a 1911 .45-caliber pistol and WWII-era ammunition. After holding up a convenience store cashier, the thief turned back and fired at the clerk—but the older ammunition experienced a hang fire, causing a delay before the round fired. The thief then died at close range when the pistol went off. What other “misfire” survival stories should we cover next?
